definitions.explanation: Comfortably warm, often in a sheltered environment.
Living an easy life without experiencing difficulties (often with slight negative nuance).

examples.japanese: ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぬくぬくして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm snuggled up warm in the futon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効|き}いた→効く：01932_kiku⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぬくぬくする。
examples.english: To be cozy and warm in a heated room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦なのに→なのに：22395_nanoni⟧、⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦こたつ→こたつ：05070_kotatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぬくぬくして⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Even though it was snowing outside, the cat was snuggled up in the kotatsu.

examples.japanese: ぬくぬく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{育|そだ}てられた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。

examples.english: Living comfortably off their parents' money.
examples.notes: Negative nuance: implies living an easy life without effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧ぬくぬく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ない→申し訳ない：20352_moushiwakenai⟧。
examples.english: I feel bad being the only one comfortably safe.

notes:
ぬくぬく is an onomatopoeia describing cozy warmth or comfortable living.

SENSE 1 - PHYSICAL WARMTH:
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぬくぬく: snuggled in the futon
- ぬくぬく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{暖|あたた}まる→暖まる：02095_atatamaru⟧: to warm up cozily
- ぬくぬく⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: a cozy warm room

SENSE 2 - SHELTERED LIFE (often negative):
- ぬくぬく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧: to grow up sheltered/pampered
- ぬくぬく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧: to live in comfort (without hardship)

VERBAL USE:
ぬくぬくする: to be cozy, to snuggle up

CONTRAST:
- ⟦ぽかぽか→ぽかぽか：05784_pokapoka⟧: warm from external heat (sun, heater)
- ⟦ほかほか→ほかほか：04837_hokahoka⟧: steaming hot (food)
- ⟦あったかい→あったかい：21494_attakai⟧/⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧: warm (general)

Note: Sense 2 can carry a critical nuance, implying someone is too comfortable and hasn't experienced real difficulties.
